summary: BIONIC™ Bug Fix Verification - All 3 reported issues have been RESOLVED. 1) Map now uses Voyager theme (colorful and readable) instead of dark theme. 2) Base map selector with 6 themes works correctly. 3) Waypoint markers now appear on the map after adding via the form.
passed_tests: ✅ Map loads with Voyager theme (colorful, readable) - NOT dark anymore
✅ Base map selector shows 6 options: Voyager, Light, Dark, Satellite, OSM, Terrain
✅ Changing base map to Satellite works - ESRI imagery loads correctly
✅ Map click captures coordinates and displays in form (46.81396°N, 71.20820°W)
✅ Waypoint form accepts name, type selection, and notes
✅ Type selector shows all 6 types with correct colors: Caméra (green), Mirador (orange), Affût (red), Saline (blue), Sentier (purple), Observation (pink)
✅ 'Ajouter le waypoint' button adds waypoint to list
✅ Waypoint markers appear on the map with correct colors (orange for Mirador)
✅ Multiple waypoints can be added and all markers are visible
✅ Header shows waypoint count (1 waypoint, 2 waypoints) and Export button
✅ WMS Layer Selector panel shows 7 couches disponibles
✅ WMS sources available: OpenStreetMap, CanVec (NRCan), USGS, NASA GIBS
✅ Activating WMS layer (NASA GIBS VIIRS) displays overlay on map
✅ Active layers badge shows '1 active' when layer is enabled
✅ 'Tout effacer' button clears all active WMS layers
✅ MapLibre GL badge visible confirming map engine is working
critical_code_review_comments: BIONIC_DARK_STYLE in maplibre.js now uses Carto Voyager (colorful) instead of Carto Dark
WMSLayerSelector.jsx includes new base map selector with 6 theme options (lines 781-848)
TerritoryMap.jsx useEffect (lines 188-224) correctly renders waypoint markers with type-based colors
TerritoryPage.jsx passes waypoints prop to TerritoryMap (line 529)
Marker colors match WAYPOINT_TYPES: camera=#22c55e, mirador=#f5a623, affut=#ef4444, saline=#3b82f6, sentier=#8b5cf6, observation=#ec4899

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 3 reported bugs fixed and verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs have been fixed: 1) Map uses Voyager theme (colorful), 2) Base map selector with 6 themes works, 3) Waypoint markers appear on map. WMS layers work with available sources (OSM, CanVec, USGS, NASA GIBS). Quebec government sources (SIGÉOM, LiDAR, GRHQ, MFFP) still require authentication and are unavailable.
